name: artcraft-apps-manager
description: Shortcuts for building, previewing and publishing ArtCraft Apps Manager. The version lives in Cargo.toml.

scripts.build: npm run build:installer && npm run build:site
scripts.preview: npm run build:site && cd site && firebase emulators:start --only hosting --project demo-artcraftappsmanager
scripts.release: npm run build:installer && npm run deploy --
